facts.fact: Decree no. 2026-422 of 1 July 2026, signed by President Wadagni, names eight members of the Autorite de Protection des Donnees a caractere personnel (one for the President, five for the National Assembly, one for the bar, one for the magistrates) and repeals the 2021 appointment decree 2021-092.
